data.message: I propose all 50 of us commit to 18 tons each: $18,000 apiece, $8,000 more than 10. Total catch 900 leaves 100: a 75% chance of recovery to 1,000, but a 25% chance of only 200 next month. By contrast, 10 each guarantees 1,000 next month. At 200 we'd need much smaller catches; excess fishing could cause collapse. This is riskier, not guaranteed sustainable. I commit to 18 if all 50 agree; otherwise I'll revisit openly. Will each of you explicitly commit, or share your objection?
